message: fix(ui): prioritize collectible loot over its overlapping carcass prompt
purpose: The live native test exposed an identifier-dependent tie between loot and its carcass. Repair displayed action selection without changing server ownership or rewards.

replacements.old: public static WorldTarget? ChooseInteraction(Character self, IEnumerable<WorldTarget> targets, Catalog data)
if (target.Kind == "node") return snapshot.Nodes.Any(x => x.Id == target.Id && x.ReadyAt <= snapshot.Time);
replacements.new:
if (target.Kind == "loot") return World.Loot.Any(x => x.Id == target.Id && ExperienceRules.LootAvailable(snapshot.Self, x, snapshot.Time));
            if (target.Kind == "node") return snapshot.Nodes.Any(x => x.Id == target.Id && x.ReadyAt <= snapshot.Time);

replacements.old: var foreign = data.Abilities.First(x => x.Class != "" && x.Class != self.Class && x.Requirement == 1);
